name: Holdfast
feature_notes: Holdfast preserves exact older Ike backup and draft records in a separate verified file. Cleanup is offered only after the saved file is verified and every record in an old copy matches current storage. Unique, changed, foreign, quarantined and unreadable records stay. Recovery counts and iPad controls are clearer. No automatic cleanup, migration retry or backend change. See HOLDFAST_GUIDE.md.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Countercraft tables, private storage and exact-vessel gateway verified. TrueFit service v2 deployed; Sea Trial remains enabled only by owner publication.
